answer:
Verdict: no

## Threads that are mostly waiting

Across the whole trace (0–30,612 ms), the watchdog was the only thread classified as idle—it never woke to do work. Apart from it, **reader (TID 645047)** is the closest match: it was blocked 98.6% of its time and ran 0.8%, but it woke 59,925 times, so it was not simply idle. The main `pipeline` thread was also mostly waiting (98.6% blocked), but woke 3,066 times.

The `parser` (TID 645046) was the thread other threads waited on most, but its measured hold-up was minor; it ran 49.1% of its time.
